title: Jhannyl's Gloves

sources.title: Defy Villainy
markers: | description = When the wearer becomes {{SmCond|Blinded}}, {{SmCond|Paralysed}} or {{SmCond|Poisoned}}, they automatically cast {{SmSAI|Lesser Restoration}} on themselves.

sources.title: Lesser Restoration
markers: | description = Cure a creature from {{Condition Type|diseased}}, {{Condition Type|poisoned}}, {{Cond|Paralysed|Paralysis}}, or {{Condition Type|blinded}}.

summary: Gain +1 to saving throws. Automatically remove qualifying conditions when they are applied.

fields.Defy Villainy: Removes conditions in the Diseased, Poisoned, Paralysed and Blinded groups, plus Bloodless. Since Patch 8 it can trigger an unlimited number of times. The passive works for player characters, recruited companions and hirelings.
fields.Actual effect: Emulates Lesser Restoration without casting it. It does not build Arcane Ward or trigger other effects that require casting a spell.
fields.Acquisition: Loot from Isobel at Last Light Inn after resolving the Nightsong before the Moonrise assault, in the Mind Flayer Colony after a kidnapping or early death, at Ramazith’s Tower after Lorroakan kills or imprisons Nightsong, or at the Act Two camp if she joins.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
